title: Request Constraints
description: Closed, bounded JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 fragment emitted and authoritatively enforced by the Business through registered `ucp.request_constraints` to narrow a corresponding representation in a later request.

object_constraint.description: A closed Object Constraint that applies standard Draft 2020-12 `required` and `properties` semantics to a corresponding submitted object.

required.description: Names of fields required in the corresponding object of the later submitted representation.

properties.description: Constraints for named fields of the corresponding object in the later submitted representation.

value_constraint.description: A Value Constraint applies standard Draft 2020-12 `enum` and/or `const` semantics to the corresponding value in the later submitted representation. When both are present, both constraints apply.

enum.description: A non-empty set of JSON values permitted for the corresponding submitted value.
